topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: Hey, I heard about what happened with your childhood friend. That must've been a real trip, you know? I mean, to find out someone who was so much a part of your life just doesn’t have those memories. It’s strange, but things like that do happen. Maybe they’re just going through a tough patch or something’s thrown their memory off. Whatever it is, it’s okay to feel all sorts of things about it. Just remember, you’re not defined by someone else’s memories. What you remember and feel is real and important, too. Take your time to sort it all out.
